sv.retired_source:
Interactive plots need pyqtgraph.

Install it with  pip install 'spacr[qt]'  and reopen this module.

Everything else works without it: the run still produces every figure, and they appear on the grid above the console.
sv.current_source:
Interactive plots need pyqtgraph.

Install it with python -m pip install spacr, then reopen this module.

Everything else works without it: the run still produces every figure, and they appear on the grid above the console.
sv.current_reviewed_target:
Interaktiva diagram kräver pyqtgraph.

Installera det med python -m pip install spacr och öppna sedan modulen igen.

Allt annat fungerar utan det: körningen skapar fortfarande alla figurer, och de visas i rutnätet ovanför konsolen.
